name: CIDR Summarization Calculator
description: Summarize contiguous IPv4 CIDR networks into the smallest exact set of aggregate CIDR blocks.
search_intent: Combine compatible IPv4 CIDR networks into fewer exact route-summary prefixes.
calculation: Parse valid IPv4 CIDRs, normalize them to network boundaries, remove exact duplicates and contained networks, and merge sibling CIDR blocks only when they are adjacent, equal-sized, correctly aligned and their parent block represents exactly their combined address space. Repeat until no further exact merges are possible.
limitations: The calculator must not create a broader summary containing addresses that were not covered by the supplied networks.
Route aggregation decisions in a live network also depend on topology and routing policy.
